title: The Boy in the Iceberg
precisionNote: Every range below is approximate. The order of scenes follows the public episode, and the clock times are rounded from a fan timed transcript (avatard.org, 'The Boy in the Iceberg'). They were not measured on Netflix. A Netflix logo, a different cut, or a few seconds of drift will push them off. English subtitles replace this guide as soon as a line matches. Tag mode replaces it too.

source.name: Rounded scene guide derived from a public timed transcript
source.note: These are scene-level ranges, not per-line Netflix timestamps. Collection mode replaces them.

katara.name: Katara

sokka.name: Sokka
sokka.description: Katara's older brother, a nonbending warrior with a boomerang and a plan.

aang.name: Aang

zuko.name: Zuko
zuko.description: Exiled prince of the Fire Nation, hunting the Avatar to restore his honor.

iroh.name: Iroh
iroh.description: Zuko's uncle, a retired general who would rather pour tea than chase glory.
